purpose: Required benign scenarios for per-client and per-network-profile staging observations.

scenarios.title: Idle and ordinary walking
scenarios.expected: No movement evidence during standing, walking and ordinary sprint movement.

scenarios.title: Jump, fall and landing
scenarios.expected: No movement evidence for ordinary jumping, falling and landing.

scenarios.title: Server-authorized teleport
scenarios.expected: No movement evidence after the host reports the legal teleport before changing position.

scenarios.title: Spawn, death and respawn
scenarios.expected: No evidence caused solely by the normal spawn/death lifecycle.

scenarios.title: Interior enter and exit
scenarios.expected: No evidence during both directions of the notified interior transition.

scenarios.title: Virtual-world enter and exit
scenarios.expected: No evidence during both directions of the notified virtual-world transition.

scenarios.title: Vehicle enter, drive and exit
scenarios.expected: No vehicle evidence for ordinary driver entry, travel and exit.

scenarios.title: Vehicle switch and ordinary collision
scenarios.expected: No evidence for representative legal vehicle switching and normal collision impulses.

scenarios.title: Spectate and restore context
scenarios.expected: No evidence from a legal spectate start/stop and context restoration; requires a second connected test client.

scenarios.title: Real disconnect and reconnect
scenarios.expected: No stale-session evidence after an actual client disconnect/reconnect; do not substitute the simulated /acstagetest reset.

scenarios.title: Ordinary activity under the selected network profile
scenarios.expected: No false evidence from ordinary movement/vehicle activity under the selected stable, high-ping, jitter, packet-loss or low-FPS profile.
